name: Og
bio: Og was the king of Bashan, who marched out his whole army to confront Israel as they turned toward his territory. The LORD told Moses, "Do not be afraid of him, for I have delivered him into your hands, along with his whole army and his land," and Israel struck down Og, his sons, and all his people, taking his entire land (Numbers 21:33-35). Deuteronomy specifically records that Og's iron bed was nine cubits long and four cubits wide, testifying to his great size; together with the defeat of the Amorite king Sihon, Og's downfall became a recurring example cited by Israel when recounting the LORD's mighty acts (Deuteronomy 3:11).
